latin-to-romance#step:0.note: Found by workers, bought by Dressel; date wording hedged; 'support the early date' removed.

latin-to-romance#step:2.note: Year moved from 600 to 650: the 7th-century regional differences and Fredegar fit better; Vulgar Latin runs to 800.

latin-to-romance#step:3.note: Source quotes Walter calling it the oldest extant French text; hedged as 'regarded as'.

latin-to-romance#step:4.note: Source says first extant documents, not strictly 'earliest'; reworded.

latin-to-romance#step:5.note: Year moved from 1150 to 1140, the start of the debated 1140-1207 range; added Per Abbad colophon 1207; removed 'anonymous'.

latin-to-romance#step:6.note: Source says oldest Old Romanian document that can be precisely dated; date most probably 29 or 30 June.
